theme: Prints wrong or hard to print
use_for: Printing problems: wrong size, cut-off pages, can't work out how to print.

theme: Slow or no delivery of files
use_for: Took a long time to get access, still waiting, or never received the files.
Many pages are copies or near-copies of each other, padding the page count.
Buyer objects that covers, images or stickers are AI-generated rather than hand-made.

theme: Had to pay again for fixes or updates
use_for: Seller released a fixed or updated version and charged existing buyers for it.
Buyer was charged more than once or more than the price shown.
Buyer got a different product or file than the one ordered.
Wants fillable or typeable pages instead of handwriting only.
Wants each sheet or page as its own file instead of one long PDF to scroll through.
